name: Decorrelated jitter
summary: A random walk that grows from the last delay rather than the attempt number. The only stateful policy here, and the one that disperses a fleet most thoroughly.

params.name: baseMs
params.description: The floor of every delay, and where the walk starts.

params.name: capMs
params.description: No delay exceeds this, however far the walk has climbed.

params.name: maxAttempts
params.description: Give up after this many attempts.

notes: The only policy in this domain that remembers anything between calls, and the only one that ignores the attempt number entirely except for the give-up check. Because whole schedules diverge rather than individual attempts, it disperses a fleet more thoroughly than any per-call draw.
